title: Week of Sep 28 - Oct 4 · Foundations Week 4: Five Lifts, Same Loads
subtitle: Same four strength nights, same five lifts a night, same two easy runs. Only one night of the Sep 14 plan made it into the log, so this week runs it again at the same loads (plus the two Tuesday numbers you already moved). Get the Monday, Thursday and Saturday versions done once, then the weights step up.
goals: Where things stand: over the last two weeks only Tuesday Sep 15 made it into the log. So this week repeats the five-lifts-a-night structure at the Sep 14 loads, and the three nights that haven't been logged yet get their first run through before anything moves up. If you did train and just didn't log, no harm, the loads were set to be one notch above your August numbers anyway.

Loads: two changes, both from Tuesday. RDL is 100 now, since you took set 3 there, and the seated cable row sits at 37 where you finished. Everything else holds: squat 75 (80 on Thursday's set 3 if Monday's three sets are smooth), bench 65 (70 on Saturday if Monday is easy), barbell row 50, pulldown 60, goblet squat 40, DB press 20s, one-arm row 20s, step-up 10s, reverse lunge 12s, weighted glute bridge 30, lateral raise 8s with face pulls at 20.

Structure is unchanged: four lift nights with two main lifts, three more lifts, the hips superset, then 6 bodyweight core sets. If a night runs long, cut the hips and core blocks to two rounds, never the five lifts. Core rotation this week: bird dog / side plank Monday, dead bug / plank Tuesday, bicycle crunch / shoulder taps Thursday, hollow hold / flutter kicks Saturday.

Runs: Wednesday and Sunday, 2 easy miles at full-sentence pace, bike swap right on the card if the knee complains. Please log them this week, even just the time and a one-word knee note, since none of the last few runs are in the log. Strava link for your profile, so runs and heart rate show up on their own: workoutplanning-production.up.railway.app/api/strava/connect/emma.
review: Foundations Week 3 (Sep 14). Tuesday Sep 15 is in the log and it went well: RDL 95, 95, then 100 on set 3, DB press 20s all three sets, goblet squat 40, seated cable row 32 then 37 and 37, the glute bridge and clamshell pair, and all six core sets, feel 'Good'. Monday, Thursday, Saturday and both runs aren't in the log, and no new plan went up last week, so the app kept showing that same week through Sep 27.

days.name: Foundation A · Squat + Bench + Step-ups
warmup: 5 min easy cardio (bike, row, or brisk walk)

items.note: 75 for all three sets. If all three are smooth 8s with no grinding on the last rep, 80 for set 3 on Thursday.
items.focus: Brace, chest tall, knees track over toes, squat to a depth you control.

items.note: 65 for all three. Same setup every set: shoulder blades pinned, feet flat, bar to mid-chest. If every set is an easy 8, Saturday goes to 70.
items.focus: Shoulder blades set, feet planted, lower to mid-chest, press up and slightly back.

items.note: 20s for every set. Strict: no torso twist, pull to the hip, 1s squeeze.
items.focus: Flat back, pull to your hip, squeeze the shoulder blade.

items.note: Box or bench about knee height, 10-lb dumbbells at your sides. Step up through the whole foot, stand fully tall at the top, step down slowly. 15s next week if 10s are easy.
items.focus: Whole foot on the box, drive through the heel, no push off the back leg, control the way down.

items.note: The hips block, unchanged. No band? March slowly in place driving each knee above hip height with a 1s hold.
items.focus: Low back stays glued to the floor on the march; toes forward and hip stacked on the leg lifts.

items.note: Core block, 6 sets: bird dog → side plank, three rounds, about 20s between moves.
items.focus: Slow and square, hips level, reach long, pause 2s each rep.
Hips stacked and lifted, straight line from head to feet. From the knees is a fine version.

stretches: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s each side

days.name: Foundation B · RDL + Press + Cable Row
warmup: 5 min easy cardio (bike, row, or brisk walk)

items.note: 100 for all three. You took set 3 to 100 on Sep 15, so it's the working weight now. Slow 2 to 3s lowering, bar dragging the thighs.
items.focus: Hips back, flat back, bar close, feel the hamstrings load.

items.note: 20s for all three, clean last time. 25s next week if set 3 stays strict.
items.focus: Squeeze glutes, ribs down, press to lockout over the ears.

items.note: 40 again. Depth and posture practice, deliberately lighter than the barbell squat nights.
items.focus: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom, chest tall, heels down.

items.note: 37 for all three, where you finished last time. If 10 is easy on set 1, go up one plate for sets 2 and 3.
items.focus: Chest up, no leaning back to finish the rep, squeeze the shoulder blades together.

items.note: The hips block, your knee insurance. Same as before, band optional on the clamshells.
items.focus: Squeeze the glute at the top of every bridge; keep the hips stacked on the clamshells.

items.note: Core block, 6 sets: dead bug → plank, three rounds.
items.focus: Ribs down, low back pressed into the floor, opposite arm and leg reach long.
Straight line head to heels, glutes tight, breathe.

stretches: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s each side

days.name: Easy Run · 2 mi (or Bike)
warmup: Ankle circles + a few walking lunges

run.title: Easy conversational run, 2 mi
run.detail: Two easy miles at full-sentence pace, walk breaks completely fine. Note how the knee feels during and after. A little awareness that fades is okay; real pain or a changed stride means stop and tap the 🚴 toggle instead. Log it even if it's just the time and one word on the knee.

hr.zone: Easy / conversational (RPE 3 to 4). Connect Strava and future runs get HR zones
hr.main: RPE 3 to 4, full sentences the whole way
hr.note: The lifting is what's pushing this week. Runs are practice moving, nothing more.

stretches: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s each side

days.name: Foundation C · Squat + Row + Push-ups
warmup: 5 min easy cardio (bike, row, or brisk walk)

items.note: 75, and if Monday's three sets were smooth, 80 on set 3 tonight. That would be a new best.
items.focus: Brace, chest tall, knees track over toes, squat to a depth you control.

items.note: 50. Hinge like your RDL, hold that angle, pull to the lower ribs, no heaving.
items.focus: Torso angle held constant, pull to the lower ribs, squeeze.

items.note: 60 for every set. 65 for set 3 if the last rep of set 2 is smooth.
items.focus: Lead with the elbows, chest up to the bar, no leaning back.

items.note: 12s, three sets. The knee-friendly lunge: long step back, front shin vertical.
items.focus: Tall torso, front heel down, knee tracks over the toes.

items.note: Three sets, stopping 2 reps before form breaks, 90s rest. Hands on a bench or the smith bar if floor push-ups aren't 6+ clean reps yet; from the knees also counts. Log the reps, this is a reps goal.
items.focus: Rigid line from head to heels, chest to an inch off the surface, full lockout.

items.n: Hip Flexor Raise + Leg Raise superset
items.note: The hips block: standing knee drives with a 2s hold at the top (add a light ankle weight or band when 8 gets easy), then 10 slow straight-leg raises.
items.focus: Tall on the standing leg, knee above hip height; on the leg raises, low back stays down.

items.note: Core block, 6 sets: bicycle crunch → shoulder taps, three rounds.
items.focus: Slow and rotational, shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Feet wide, hips dead still, tap slowly.

stretches: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s each side

days.name: Rest Day (Sculpt Counts)
days.desc: Rest. Sculpt, a gentle walk, or easy hip stretching all fit here, or nothing at all. Just log whatever happens.
fields: What did you do? (fine if nothing)
How sore are you, 1 to 10, and where?

days.name: Foundation D · Bench + RDL + Shoulders
warmup: 5 min easy cardio (bike, row, or brisk walk)

items.note: 65, or 70 if Monday's three sets were easy 8s. Second bench night of the week, same setup.
items.focus: Shoulder blades set, feet planted, lower to mid-chest, press up and slightly back.

items.note: 100 for all three, same as Tuesday, or 105 if Tuesday was clean all the way through. If the back rounds or the bar drifts away, drop 5 and finish clean.
items.focus: Hips back, flat back, bar close, feel the hamstrings load.

items.note: 30 across the hips (folded towel), pause 1s at the top of every rep.
items.focus: Ribs down, squeeze the glutes to lift, don't arch the low back.

items.note: 8-lb dumbbells for the raises (slight bend in the elbows, stop at shoulder height), then 15 face pulls on the cable rope at 20. Three rounds.
items.focus: Raises: lead with the elbows, no shrug. Face pulls: elbows high, rope apart, squeeze the back of the shoulders.

items.note: The hips block: banded side-steps into the psoas march. Third hip flexor touch of the week.
items.focus: Stay low on the walks, toes forward; slow controlled knee drives on the march.

items.note: Core block, 6 sets: hollow hold → flutter kicks, three rounds. Bend the knees if your low back arches.
items.focus: Low back pressed down, ribs in, arms and legs long.
Small and quick, low back stays glued down.

stretches: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s each side
